entry.title: Mir Castle Complex
entry.note: Fresh exact-Q209643 relation 1579104 v31 and retained component polygons agree within 0.683 mm. Native +X east-southeast at 102.866 degrees, +Z south-southwest at 192.866 degrees; west gate, differently colored corner towers, north/east palace wings and north bridge sign heading -0.224560956675. Retained Terrarium numeric terrain forms a 4225-value 4 m native grid. Y0 is decoded 175.0822 m anchor working datum, not surveyed regional/ellipsoidal elevation. Reconstructed court floor 0.375 m above anchor uses highest sample inside occupied rectangle plus 0.25 m. One rigid translation preserves relative facade/roof heights. Occupied mapped feet and bridge piers extend four meters below retained grade. Northern path/steps and narrow west gate connector meet retained ground; approach elevations, embankment widths and vertical survey remain approximate. No whole-precinct terrain replacement or cutout. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
